Apr 2-9: Tariff announcement, near-bear market (-19% peak-to-trough)

Those runs used the MAX_HOLD bug (avg hold ~1 day, 80% of positions force-closed day 1).
Trade count, hold duration, and stop hit rates from old runs are meaningless vs this run.
Return comparison may also be unreliable - treat this as a clean-sheet 2-year result.
